record.question: What does the Crabtree route display geometry establish?
record.reason: Reviewed USFS source vertices now draw the existing Camp/Bear approaches. Accuracy is unspecified and this is not navigation-grade or a current-condition survey. Camp western access is a descriptive display position at a source-feature break, not a lake centroid or campsite. The nearby Lake Valley source endpoint has a small coordinate mismatch; no branch is snapped or added. Other Emigrant routes, lake shores, facility positions and the wilderness boundary still lack reviewed display geometry.
